name: GPT-3 175B

release_date.note: arXiv v1 of the paper; weights never released

tokenizer.note: reuses GPT-2's byte-level BPE (paper sections 2.1 and 3.3)

stack.note: alternating dense (global) and locally banded sparse (local) layers; the paper does not say which comes first

steps.label: 96 heads x 128; dense or locally banded sparse, by layer

specials.name: local_global
specials.what: attention alternates between dense and locally banded sparse patterns, as in the Sparse Transformer

specials.name: residual_init_scaling
specials.what: GPT-2's modified initialisation, which scales residual-layer weights with depth

paper.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
paper.note: Table 2.1, section 2.1; arXiv API: v1 published 2020-05-28

gpt2.title: Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners
gpt2.note: section 2.3: LayerNorm at sub-block input, extra LayerNorm after the last block, learned positions

unknowns.vocab_size: paper says it reuses GPT-2's BPE but gives no embedding size
unknowns.attention.window: band width of the locally banded sparse layers is not published
unknowns.ffn.activation: not named in the GPT-3 or GPT-2 papers
unknowns.block_order: order taken from the paper's statement that the model follows GPT-2 with pre-normalisation; no code

notes: Position, norm placement and qk_norm rest on the paper's statement that it uses 'the same model and architecture as GPT-2' apart from the sparse layers.
kv_heads equals heads: the paper describes no key/value sharing.

local.note: locally banded sparse attention; band width not published
